srList.sentence: Statistical analysis All data in the present study were analyzed using SPSS19.0 for Windows ( SPSS Inc . , Chicago , IL)

sentenceParts.c: Statistical analysis All data in the present study were analyzed using SPSS19.0 for Windows ( SPSS Inc . , Chicago , IL)

srList.sentence: The inclusion criteria included all adult patients who met all the diagnostic criteria from the Berlin definition of ARDS (11), who had been hospitalized in the EICU for longer than 24 h, and for whom there existed complete clinical data.

sentenceParts.c: The inclusion criteria included all adult patients who met all the diagnostic criteria from the Berlin definition of ARDS (11), who had been hospitalized in the EICU for longer than 24 h, and for whom there existed complete clinical data.

srList.sentence: Patients were excluded if the following criteria were met: (1) they were younger than the age of 18 (2) they had pre-existing chronic kidney disease (defined as an estimated glomerular filtration rate less than 60 mLmin1.73 m2(12)) or receiving renal replacement therapy before admission (3) they had suffered AKI prior to ARDS onset (4) they displayed evidence of renal transplantation (5) they had a history of long-term use of nephrotoxic drugs (6) they had a history of malignancy and haematologic disorder.

sentenceParts.c: Patients were excluded if the following criteria were met: (1) they were younger than the age of 18 (2) they had pre-existing chronic kidney disease (defined as an estimated glomerular filtration rate less than 60 mLmin1.73 m2(12)) or receiving renal replacement therapy before admission (3) they had suffered AKI prior to ARDS onset (4) they displayed evidence of renal transplantation (5) they had a history of long-term use of nephrotoxic drugs (6) they had a history of malignancy and haematologic disorder.

srList.sentence: Normally distributed continuous variables were presented as means +- standard deviation and compared using Students t test.

sentenceParts.c: Normally distributed continuous variables were presented as means +- standard deviation and compared using Students t test.

srList.sentence: Non-normally distributed continuous data were presented as median with interquartile ranges and compared using Mann-Whitney U test.

sentenceParts.c: Non-normally distributed continuous data were presented as median with interquartile ranges and compared using Mann-Whitney U test.

srList.sentence: Categorical data were presented as frequencies and percentages, and compared using Fishers exact test, or chi-square test where appropriate.

sentenceParts.c: Categorical data were presented as frequencies and percentages, and compared using Fishers exact test, or chi-square test where appropriate.

srList.sentence: Survival curves were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and the mortality of each group was compared with the log-rank test.
